title: The Sunday Read: ‘The Waco Biker Shootout Left Nine Dead. Why Was No One Convicted?’

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即便是在我还在夜店打碟的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的收藏去工作，把DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Mark Benelli and I'm a contributing writer to The New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫马克·贝内利，是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: So I remember first coming across the Waco biker story in 2015.
sentences.zh: 我记得第一次看到韦科摩托车帮派事件是在2015年。

sentences.en: It made national headlines.
sentences.zh: 那件事上了全国头条。

sentences.en: Massive biker brawl on broad daylight in Waco, Texas.
sentences.zh: 在德克萨斯州韦科市的青天白日下，爆发了一场大规模的摩托车帮派混战。

sentences.en: 200 arrests, 9 dead.
sentences.zh: 200人被捕，9人死亡。

sentences.en: My reaction at the time was, of course, wow, what a crazy story.
sentences.zh: 我当时的反应当然是：哇，真是个疯狂的故事。

sentences.en: But also to some degree, a dog bites man.
sentences.zh: 但某种程度上，这也算是“狗咬人”的寻常事。

sentences.en: Marauding bikers.
sentences.zh: 横行霸道的摩托车手。

sentences.en: Isn't that what bikers do?
sentences.zh: 这不就是他们会做的事吗？

sentences.en: The incident itself was a territorial dispute between an outlaw motorcycle club called the Bandidos and a rival club, the Cossacks, who were smaller but growing.
sentences.zh: 事件本身是“强盗”摩托车俱乐部与一个规模较小但正在壮大的竞争对手“哥萨克”俱乐部之间的地盘争端。

sentences.en: The Bandidos are basically the Hells Angels of Texas, the biggest and most feared club in the state.
sentences.zh: “强盗”基本上就是德州的“地狱天使”，是该州规模最大、最令人恐惧的俱乐部。

sentences.en: Federal and state law enforcement consider the Bandidos a serious criminal gang.
sentences.zh: 联邦和州执法部门将“强盗”视为一个严重的犯罪团伙。

sentences.en: And at the time of the incident, the police in Waco had been made aware of the increased tension between the two clubs.
sentences.zh: 在事件发生时，韦科警方已经意识到这两个俱乐部之间的紧张局势正在加剧。

sentences.en: There was a concern when a large meeting of bikers was scheduled to take place in the spring of 2015 that it could become a combustible situation.
sentences.zh: 当时人们担心，2015年春天计划举行的大规模摩托车手聚会可能会演变成一场一触即发的冲突。

sentences.en: The meeting took place at 1 p.m.
sentences.zh: 聚会定在下午1点举行，

sentences.en: on a Sunday afternoon at a restaurant in Waco called Twin Peaks, a Hooters-style chain in Texas where the waitresses wear lumberjack halter tops.
sentences.zh: 地点是韦科一家名为“双峰”的餐厅，这是一家德州连锁店，风格类似猫头鹰餐厅，女服务员穿着伐木工风格的挂脖上衣。

sentences.en: Shortly after the Dallas chapter of the Bandidos arrived, utter mayhem erupted.
sentences.zh: 在“强盗”达拉斯分会抵达后不久，彻底的混乱爆发了。

sentences.en: On police dashcam footage, you can see bikers swinging chains, waving guns, beating other bikers to the ground.
sentences.zh: 在警方的行车记录仪画面中，你可以看到摩托车手挥舞着铁链和枪支，将其他人打倒在地。

sentences.en: You can also see bikers being shot by the police.
sentences.zh: 你还能看到摩托车手被警察射击。

sentences.en: In the end, nine people died.
sentences.zh: 最终，九人死亡。

sentences.en: Nearly 20 were seriously injured.
sentences.zh: 近二十人受重伤。

sentences.en: The fact that this happened so brazenly in a sprawling strip mall parking lot in broad daylight made the story very briefly national news.
sentences.zh: 这件事在光天化日之下发生在一个庞大的购物中心停车场，这种肆无忌惮的行为让这个故事短暂地成为了全国新闻。

sentences.en: And then some years passed.
sentences.zh: 后来几年过去了。

sentences.en: I'd forgotten about the story.
sentences.zh: 我已经忘了这个故事。

sentences.en: And then I came across an update, probably on one of the anniversaries of the event,
sentences.zh: 直到后来我看到了一篇后续报道，大概是在事件周年纪念的时候，

sentences.en: in which I learned that not one of the 177 bikers arrested that day had been successfully prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 我得知那天被捕的177名摩托车手中，没有一个人被成功起诉。

sentences.en: Everyone present had walked.
sentences.zh: 所有在场的人都脱罪了。

sentences.en: As a writer, I immediately sensed this could be the kind of story I like to dive into.
sentences.zh: 作为一名作家，我立刻感觉到这可能是我喜欢深入挖掘的那种故事。

sentences.en: Because you read the initial headline and you think you understand the narrative.
sentences.zh: 因为你读了最初的头条新闻，你以为自己了解了事情的经过。

sentences.en: You think you know who the bad guys are.
sentences.zh: 你以为你知道谁是坏人。

sentences.en: And maybe some of them are bad guys.
sentences.zh: 也许他们中有些人确实是坏人。

sentences.en: But the story turns out to be so much more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，这个故事远比那复杂得多。

sentences.en: And it begins to twist and turn in ways you never would have guessed at the outset.
sentences.zh: 它开始以你起初绝对想不到的方式扭转和发展。

sentences.en: The 177 arrested bikers faced identical criminal conspiracy charges.
sentences.zh: 那177名被捕的摩托车手面临着相同的刑事共谋指控。

sentences.en: Regardless of what they actually did that day.
sentences.zh: 无论他们那天实际上做了什么。

sentences.en: And would serve 15 years to life if found guilty.
sentences.zh: 如果罪名成立，他们将面临15年到终身监禁的刑罚。

sentences.en: But soon after the arrests, stories began to emerge that made it clear at least some of those arrested had no criminal records.
sentences.zh: 但在逮捕后不久，开始有消息传出，清楚地表明至少有一些被捕者没有犯罪记录。

sentences.en: Were not members of the banditos or the Cossacks.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不是“强盗”或“哥萨克”的成员。

sentences.en: They just seemed to be regular motorcycle enthusiasts who were in the wrong place at the wrong time.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来只是普通的摩托车爱好者，在错误的时间出现在了错误的地点。

sentences.en: Arrested simply for wearing biker colors.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为穿着摩托车帮派的服饰就被捕了。

sentences.en: And they're telling victims of an overzealous local prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 他们声称自己是当地检察官过度热心的受害者。

sentences.en: So when I returned to the story years later, and then began to dig deeper, my initial idea of what happened that day in Waco got turned on its head.
sentences.zh: 所以当我多年后重新审视这个故事并开始深入挖掘时，我对那天在韦科发生的事情的最初看法被彻底颠覆了。

sentences.en: I reached out to a defense lawyer named Paul Looney, who had represented some of the bikers.
sentences.zh: 我联系了一位名叫保罗·鲁尼的辩护律师，他曾代表过其中一些摩托车手。

sentences.en: One of the first things he said to me was, if you want to know about Waco, there's one person who knows more about that case than anyone else in the world.
sentences.zh: 他对我说的第一件事就是：如果你想了解韦科事件，有一个人比世界上任何人都更了解这个案子。

sentences.en: And that's my trial preparation specialist, Roxanne.
sentences.zh: 那就是我的庭审准备专家，罗克珊。

sentences.en: That immediately intrigued me.
sentences.zh: 这立刻引起了我的兴趣。

sentences.en: And so in March of 2020, I flew to Norman, Oklahoma to meet her and Paul and begin reporting this piece.
sentences.zh: 于是，2020年3月，我飞往俄克拉荷马州的诺曼市去见她和保罗，开始报道这篇稿件。

sentences.en: So here's my story, read by Robert Petkoff.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的故事，由罗伯特·佩特科夫朗读。

sentences.en: This was recorded by Autumn.
sentences.zh: 由Autumn录制。

sentences.en: To listen to more stories from The New York Times, The New Yorker, Vanity Fair, The Atlantic, and other publications on your smartphone,
sentences.zh: 想在智能手机上收听更多来自《纽约时报》、《纽约客》、《名利场》、《大西洋月刊》及其他出版物的故事，

sentences.en: download Autumn on the App Store or the Play Store.
sentences.zh: 请在App Store或Play Store下载Autumn。

sentences.en: Visit audm.com for more details.
sentences.zh: 访问audm.com了解更多详情。

sentences.en: If you ask Paul Looney, a Houston defense attorney, about the Twin Peaks biker case, he'll tell you there's one person who knows more about it than anyone else alive.
sentences.zh: 如果你问休斯顿辩护律师保罗·鲁尼关于“双峰”摩托车帮派案的情况，他会告诉你，有一个人比任何在世的人都更了解它。

sentences.en: His trial preparation specialist, Roxanne Avery.
sentences.zh: 那就是他的庭审准备专家，罗克珊·艾弗里。

sentences.en: An entire wall of her home office in Norman, Oklahoma is covered with wallet-sized mugshots of the nearly 200 bikers arrested,
sentences.zh: 她在俄克拉荷马州诺曼市的家庭办公室里，整面墙上贴满了近200名被捕摩托车手的钱包大小的入案照，

sentences.en: as well as photographs of the nine men who died that day seven years ago after a violent brawl in a Waco parking lot.
sentences.zh: 还有七年前那场韦科停车场暴力混战中死亡的九名男子的照片。

sentences.en: Each picture is layered with post-it notes and details about the subjects.
sentences.zh: 每张照片上都贴满了便利贴，写着关于当事人的详细信息。

sentences.en: Ages, road names, cheech, chain, drama, sidetrack, saint, mad dog, peepaw, bubba, bubba earl, bashful, yogi, reno, creeper, grumpy dan, club affiliations, ranks,
sentences.zh: 年龄、绰号（如Cheech、Chain、Drama、Sidetrack、Saint、Mad Dog、Peepaw、Bubba、Bubba Earl、Bashful、Yogi、Reno、Creeper、Grumpy Dan）、俱乐部归属、职级，

sentences.en: descriptions of injuries,
sentences.zh: 伤情描述，

sentences.en: bullet entered neck, partially exited, paralyzed from the waist down, dead.
sentences.zh: 子弹射入颈部，部分穿出，腰部以下瘫痪，死亡。

sentences.en: And any other pertinent information.
sentences.zh: 以及任何其他相关信息。

sentences.en: I met him March 2018.
sentences.zh: 我是在2018年3月见到他的。

sentences.en: Nine millimeter Glock.
sentences.zh: 9毫米格洛克手枪。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: Army.
sentences.zh: 陆军。

sentences.en: Two tours, Iraq.
sentences.zh: 两次服役，伊拉克。

sentences.en: Convicted felon.
sentences.zh: 重罪犯。

sentences.en: Shot dog?
sentences.zh: 射杀过狗？

sentences.en: Did not see anything.
sentences.zh: 什么都没看见。

sentences.en: Graduate, Baylor University with English degree.
sentences.zh: 贝勒大学毕业生，英语学位。

sentences.en: Point to a random photograph and Avery will generally be able to squint and tell you something about the biker in question.
sentences.zh: 随便指一张照片，艾弗里通常都能眯着眼告诉你关于那个摩托车手的一些情况。

sentences.en: There's a rumor that he killed somebody, she said one morning two years ago, tapping a face.
sentences.zh: “有传言说他杀过人，”她两年前的一个早晨指着一张脸说。

sentences.en: I don't think it's true.
sentences.zh: “我不认为这是真的。”

sentences.en: I know these guys.
sentences.zh: “我了解这些人。”

sentences.en: She wore a large black onyx ring and brilliant cherry red lipstick.
sentences.zh: 她戴着一枚巨大的黑玛瑙戒指，涂着鲜艳的樱桃红口红。

sentences.en: One of her chihuahuas, Bonnie, padded by in a white dress with a red bow.
sentences.zh: 她的一只吉娃娃犬邦妮穿着一件带有红色蝴蝶结的白色连衣裙，小跑着经过。

sentences.en: Moving to a large computer monitor, Avery began to click through crime scene photographs, many of them graphic close-ups of dead bodies.
sentences.zh: 走到一台大显示器前，艾弗里开始点击查看犯罪现场的照片，其中许多是死者尸体的血腥特写。

sentences.en: So he's got a gunshot wound that you see is in his face and his eye, she noted, pausing at a particularly grisly image.
sentences.zh: “你看，他的枪伤在脸上和眼睛里，”她指着一张特别恐怖的照片说道。

sentences.en: The other one entered through his back and exited out.
sentences.zh: “另一颗子弹从他背部射入，然后穿出。”

sentences.en: Avery and her boss make a colorful duo.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里和她的老板是一对很有个性的搭档。

sentences.en: Looney speaks in a mellifluous Texas drawl, wears bolo ties and cowboy boots, and pilots his own plane to court hearings outside Houston.
sentences.zh: 鲁尼说话带着悦耳的德州口音，系着波洛领带，穿着牛仔靴，还驾驶自己的飞机去休斯顿以外的地方参加法庭听证会。

sentences.en: I've always been this close to being a criminal myself, he told me.
sentences.zh: “我一直觉得自己离罪犯只有一步之遥，”他告诉我。

sentences.en: I could have either become a mafioso don or a criminal defense lawyer, but there was no place that I could apply my personality effectively except those two places.
sentences.zh: “我本可以成为黑手党教父，也可以成为刑事辩护律师，除了这两个地方，没有别处能让我有效地发挥我的个性。”

sentences.en: Looney has appeared before courts in 41 states.
sentences.zh: 鲁尼曾在41个州的法院出庭。

sentences.en: He has done a whole bunch of work for drug cartels, he explained, and their people get arrested all over the country.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，他为贩毒集团做了大量工作，他们的人在全国各地被捕。

sentences.en: Avery likes to make Better Call Paul jokes.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里喜欢开“打给保罗吧”的玩笑。

sentences.en: They met in 2002 when Avery needed a lawyer herself.
sentences.zh: 他们相识于2002年，当时艾弗里自己需要一名律师。

sentences.en: After her husband, an OB-GYN, died of a heart attack, she hired other doctors and continued to own and operate his clinic,
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫是一名妇产科医生，死于心脏病发作，她雇佣了其他医生并继续经营他的诊所，

sentences.en: until a competitor reported her to local authorities for practicing medicine without a license.
sentences.zh: 直到一名竞争对手向当地有关部门举报她无证行医。

sentences.en: Her best friend put her in touch with Looney, who flew out and cleared up the matter.
sentences.zh: 她最好的朋友帮她联系了鲁尼，鲁尼飞过来解决了这件事。

sentences.en: Avery began to work for him in 2013, writing news releases and sitting second chair at trial as his discovery expert.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里于2013年开始为他工作，负责撰写新闻稿，并在庭审中担任他的证据专家，坐在第二席。

sentences.en: She was initially put off by the idea of defending people who might well be guilty, but she had always been drawn to true crime stories.
sentences.zh: 起初，她对为那些很可能有罪的人辩护感到反感，但她一直对真实犯罪故事很感兴趣。

sentences.en: Her grandparents' farm in Kansas wasn't far from the clutters, made infamous by In Cold Blood.
sentences.zh: 她在堪萨斯州祖父母的农场离克拉特一家不远，那家人因《冷血》一书而臭名昭著。

sentences.en: And her mother used to tell her stories about how nobody in town liked Truman Capote.
sentences.zh: 她母亲过去常给她讲镇上没人喜欢杜鲁门·卡波特的故事。

sentences.en: So the job wound up suiting her.
sentences.zh: 所以这份工作最终很适合她。

sentences.en: She was the one who told Looney about the Waco brawl in the first place.
sentences.zh: 当初正是她告诉鲁尼关于韦科混战的事。

sentences.en: In May 2015, the bikers were gathering for a meeting of the Texas Confederation of Clubs and Independence,
sentences.zh: 2015年5月，摩托车手们聚集在一起参加“德州俱乐部与独立联合会”的会议，

sentences.en: a coalition of motorcycle enthusiasts that lobbies the state government over things like helmet laws.
sentences.zh: 这是一个摩托车爱好者联盟，就头盔法等问题向州政府进行游说。

sentences.en: These meetings were typically low-key affairs.
sentences.zh: 这些会议通常都很低调。

sentences.en: The Waco event was planned for 1 p.m.
sentences.zh: 韦科活动原定于下午1点举行，

sentences.en: on a Sunday at a Hooters-style chain restaurant called Twin Peaks, where the waitresses wear lumberjack plaid halter tops.
sentences.zh: 地点在一家名为“双峰”的猫头鹰风格连锁餐厅，女服务员穿着伐木工风格的格子挂脖上衣。

sentences.en: But this meeting was preceded by rumblings of an escalating feud between two of the state's biggest outlaw motorcycle clubs, the Cossacks and the Bandidos.
sentences.zh: 但在这次会议之前，州内两个最大的非法摩托车俱乐部——“哥萨克”和“强盗”之间，已经传出了矛盾升级的流言。

sentences.en: Moments after the Bandidos arrived at Twin Peaks, a fistfight broke out, followed by gunfire, then utter havoc.
sentences.zh: 在“强盗”抵达“双峰”餐厅后不久，一场拳斗爆发，随后是枪声，接着是彻底的混乱。

sentences.en: One Waco police officer described the aftermath as looking like something out of a video game.
sentences.zh: 一名韦科警官形容事后现场看起来就像电子游戏里的场景。

sentences.en: Blood-stained concrete.
sentences.zh: 血迹斑斑的混凝土。

sentences.en: Guns.
sentences.zh: 枪支。

sentences.en: Knives.
sentences.zh: 刀具。

sentences.en: Brass knuckles and batons scattered across the scene.
sentences.zh: 指虎和警棍散落在现场。

sentences.en: Nine dead.
sentences.zh: 九人死亡。

sentences.en: Twenty wounded.
sentences.zh: 二十人受伤。

sentences.en: In 34 years of law enforcement, a spokesperson for the Waco Police Department told reporters, it was the most violent crime scene I have ever been involved in.
sentences.zh: 韦科警察局的一位发言人告诉记者，在他34年的执法生涯中，这是他参与过的最暴力的犯罪现场。

sentences.en: The police ended up arresting 177 bikers, an event described in this newspaper as what appears to be the largest roundup and mass arrest of bikers in recent American history.
sentences.zh: 警方最终逮捕了177名摩托车手，本报将此事件描述为“美国近代史上最大规模的摩托车手围捕和集体逮捕行动”。

sentences.en: The event quickly became a national story.
sentences.zh: 该事件迅速成为全国性新闻。

sentences.en: Like the average news consumer, Looney first reacted to all this with astonishment.
sentences.zh: 像普通新闻消费者一样，鲁尼最初对这一切感到震惊。

sentences.en: Sunday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 周日下午。

sentences.en: Gunfire everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是枪声。

sentences.en: Nine dead.
sentences.zh: 九人死亡。

sentences.en: But as he followed the narrative over the next week, he became suspicious.
sentences.zh: 但随着他在接下来的一周里关注事态发展，他开始产生怀疑。

sentences.en: The 177 arrests seemed awfully high, and all the bikers, regardless of the evidence against them, were slapped with identical felony charges and million-dollar bonds.
sentences.zh: 177人的逮捕人数似乎高得离谱，而且所有的摩托车手，无论证据如何，都被强加了相同的重罪指控和百万美元的保释金。

sentences.en: I just couldn't believe it, Looney told me.
sentences.zh: “我简直不敢相信，”鲁尼告诉我。

sentences.en: It defied credibility.
sentences.zh: 这违背了常理。

sentences.en: While the DA's office issued news releases and mugshots of the bikers were splashed across newspapers throughout the state,

sentences.zh: 所以我叫上罗克珊，对她说：

sentences.zh: 威廉33岁，是一名失业的焊工，也是曾在伊拉克服役的海军陆战队老兵。

sentences.zh: 他之前唯一的逮捕记录是酒后驾驶。

sentences.zh: 摩根没有犯罪记录。

sentences.zh: 但在客户被监禁的第二天，

sentences.en: Attorney's Office concurred, and the client went free.

sentences.en: Less than three months before the Waco brawl, the Texas Department of Public Safety issued an internal memo warning that the bandidos were
sentences.zh: 3月22日，一名叫亚瑟·杨的男子在德克萨斯州戈登市加油时，穿着他的“哥萨克”背心。

sentences.en: displeased with the Cossacks.

sentences.zh: 3月22日，一个名叫亚瑟·杨的男子在德克萨斯州戈登市加油时，身上穿着他的哥萨克背心。

sentences.en: While he was filling up his Harley Davidson, he said, between 10 and 15 men in bandidos' vests and T-shirts pulled up and ordered him to remove it.
sentences.zh: 当他正在给他的哈雷戴维森摩托车加油时，他说，有10到15名穿着“强盗”帮派背心和T恤的男子围了上来，命令他把车挪走。

sentences.en: When he refused, they beat him with fists and a claw hammer, leaving him with a head wound requiring 12 staples.

sentences.en: The same day, a group of Cossacks forced a bandido off I-35 and beat him with a chain, pipe, and baton before stealing his motorcycle.

sentences.en: One Cossack, he requested anonymity, call him W, his first initial, received his own warning about the meeting.

sentences.en: He can rattle off the date he joined the club without hesitation, like one of his kids' birthdays, and by the time of the meeting, he had become a sergeant-at-arms
sentences.zh: 他能毫不犹豫地脱口而出他加入俱乐部的日期，就像记得他孩子们的生日一样。到会议召开时，他已经成为了一名纠察长，

sentences.en: in charge of security, which made his presence in Waco mandatory.
sentences.zh: 负责安保工作，这使得他必须出席在韦科举行的会议。

sentences.en: W called his team of enforcers Coolers, a homage to Roadhouse, the Patrick Swayze movie about bouncers.
sentences.zh: W把他的执法团队称为“冷静者”，这是向帕特里克·斯威兹主演的关于保镖的电影《威龙杀阵》致敬。

sentences.en: We're not bouncing heads, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们不是去撞击别人的脑袋。

sentences.en: We're cooling them, until you put us in a position where we can't.
sentences.zh: 我们是让他们冷静下来，除非你们把我们逼到无法冷静的地步。

sentences.en: A source called him the night before the meeting to say that something might kick up.
sentences.zh: 一位消息人士在会议前一天晚上打电话给他，说可能会出事。

sentences.en: On Sunday morning, a group gathered at the clubhouse of the bandidos' Dallas chapter.
sentences.zh: 周日上午，一群人聚集在“强盗”帮派达拉斯分会的会所。

sentences.en: It included Jake Carazel, the 33-year-old vice president of the chapter, a railroad engineer with copious tattoos and a long beard,
sentences.zh: 其中包括33岁的分会副主席杰克·卡拉泽尔，他是一名铁路工程师，身上纹着大量纹身，留着长胡子，

sentences.en: the type of guy who wouldn't look entirely out of place selling artisanal sourdough at a farmer's market.

sentences.zh: “不求怜悯”和“Milandro”，

sentences.en: Outlaw motorcycle clubs are exclusively male and also tend to be segregated into black and white groups, though the bandidos have Latino members such as Carazel.
sentences.zh: 非法摩托车俱乐部成员均为男性，且往往按黑人和白人分组，尽管“强盗”帮派也有像卡拉泽尔这样的拉丁裔成员。

sentences.en: Later, asked about the vest in court,
sentences.zh: 后来，在法庭上被问及这件背心时，

sentences.zh: 卡拉泽尔坚持说：

sentences.zh: 你们是在断章取义地利用我们的徽章和文化来对付我们。

sentences.en: It's not meant to be as literal as law enforcement is taking it.
sentences.zh: 它并不像执法部门所理解的那样字面化。

sentences.zh: 韦科警察局确实似乎既从字面上理解，又非常严肃地对待这些骑手。

sentences.en: Earlier in the month,
sentences.zh: 本月早些时候，

sentences.zh: 帮派情报组的侦探杰夫·罗杰斯发出了自己的电子邮件，警告同事们，如果“哥萨克”试图参加这次会议或出现在该地点，

sentences.zh: 发生暴力的可能性非常高。

sentences.zh: 在Twin Peaks餐厅担任调酒师的19岁女孩凯莉·鲍登刚到岗准备午班时，经理告诉她，警察已经给总部打了电话，

sentences.zh: 并试图让他们完全取消这次会议。

sentences.zh: 经理说，我想他们没意识到我们是一家加盟店。

sentences.zh: 这家餐厅位于一个庞大的露天购物中心，旁边还有像Bed Bath & Beyond这样的大型连锁店。

sentences.en: The Cossacks began arriving early, along with so-called support clubs, smaller groups affiliated with one or the other of the bigger gangs.

sentences.zh: 这是摩托车手群体中的跨教派传教士。

sentences.en: The Vice Grips from Austin showed up on beautifully restored pre-1970s Harleys.
sentences.zh: 来自奥斯汀的“虎钳”俱乐部骑着修复精美的1970年前的哈雷摩托车出现了。

sentences.en: Jacqueline Gansk, a server, happened to be on the patio near some Cossacks when the Bandidos arrived, with Karazel and his uncle, the president of the Dallas chapter,
sentences.zh: 当“强盗”帮派到达时，服务员杰奎琳·甘斯恰好在露台上靠近一些“哥萨克”成员的地方，卡拉泽尔和他的叔叔——达拉斯分会的主席——

sentences.en: leading the pack.
sentences.zh: 带头走在前面。

sentences.en: I looked across and saw it was Dallas,
sentences.zh: 我看向对面，看到是达拉斯的人，

sentences.en: W told me, and I'm going, wait a minute,
sentences.zh: W告诉我，我当时想，等一下，

sentences.zh: 达拉斯的人通常不参加COC会议。

sentences.en: I went around to my sergeants-at-arms and said, guys, be alert, find your perimeter.
sentences.zh: 我走到我的纠察长身边说，伙计们，保持警惕，守住你们的防线。

sentences.en: When Gansk asked what was going on, someone told her to shut up.
sentences.zh: 当甘斯问发生了什么事时，有人叫她闭嘴。

sentences.zh: 加盟店经营者拒绝了让下班警察巡逻摩托车活动的提议。

sentences.zh: 相反，警方将身穿制服的警察（主要是特警队成员）部署在停车场，希望他们的出现能起到威慑作用。

sentences.en: Two of them,
sentences.zh: 其中两名警察，

sentences.zh: 迈克尔·布彻和希思·杰克逊到达后发现，餐厅后面的停车场里有75到100名骑手，许多人穿着“强盗”帮派的红金配色服装，大多数人腰间都带着刀。

sentences.en: Some, Butcher later claimed, seemed to be stretching, limbering up.
sentences.zh: 布彻后来声称，有些人似乎在做伸展运动，活动筋骨。

sentences.en: When Rogers came on the radio and said there appeared to be some tension at the front of the restaurant,
sentences.zh: 当罗杰斯在无线电中说餐厅前部似乎有些紧张时，

sentences.zh: 布彻开车绕过去，发现露台旁大约有200名骑手，他们的排列方式让他想起了围在教练身边的橄榄球队。

sentences.en: His face was red.
sentences.zh: 他的脸涨得通红。

sentences.zh: 他掏出一把长枪管的银色左轮手枪，让她想起了《肮脏哈里》里的枪。

sentences.en: When he opened fire,
sentences.zh: 当他开火时，

sentences.zh: 科尔西躲到了桌子底下。

sentences.en: She heard a second shot.
sentences.zh: 她听到了第二声枪响。

sentences.en: More punches follow.
sentences.zh: 随后出现了更多的拳头。

sentences.en: Then, the crowd pulses like a single organism before scattering as the first gunshot is fired.
sentences.zh: 接着，当第一声枪响响起时，人群像一个单一的有机体一样跳动，然后四散奔逃。

sentences.zh: 骑手们向四面八方奔跑，躲在车辆后面，趴在地上。

sentences.en: As Jackson, a Marine Corps veteran, exited the patrol vehicle with his rifle, a round struck the doorframe.
sentences.zh: 当海军陆战队退伍军人杰克逊带着步枪走出巡逻车时，一颗子弹击中了门框。

sentences.en: Amid the chaos, he would later report, he saw a man calmly aiming a revolver as if preparing to execute someone on the ground.
sentences.zh: 他后来报告说，在混乱中，他看到一个人冷静地瞄准左轮手枪，仿佛准备处决地上的人。

sentences.zh: 杰克逊决定瞄准头部射击。
